description: This file implements an Express middleware for Cognito/JWKS-based authentication, verifying JWT tokens, extracting user info, and handling fallback scenarios for local testing.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with in-memory caching for JWKS.

methods.name: getJwks
methods.description: Retrieves JWKS (JSON Web Key Set) from configured URL, with caching.

methods.name: jwkToPem
methods.description: Converts a JWK RSA key to PEM format for verification.

methods.name: getPemForKid
methods.description: Finds the PEM key corresponding to a given key ID (kid) from JWKS.

methods.name: extractToken
methods.description: Extracts JWT token from Authorization header, body, or query parameters.

methods.name: verifyOrDecodeToken
methods.description: Verifies JWT using JWKS or decodes it in fallback mode for local testing.

methods.name: resolveTenantId
methods.description: Determines tenant ID from payload or request headers.

methods.name: cognitoAuthMiddleware
methods.description: Express middleware that authenticates requests via JWT, attaching user info to request object.
